name: @papercusp/cart-drawer
description: Themable, backend-agnostic cart drawer shell: Vaul panel + @papercusp/drawer-stack registration, line-item cards with quantity stepper, saved-line mask, totals math, open/add events, fly-to-rail ghosts. All data ops stay in the consuming app (CartAdapter-by-props); all visual identity flows through --cd-* CSS custom properties.
